description: Read a public HTTPS Moxfield or Archidekt deck URL without credentials/query parameters. Returns quantity-prefixed main-deck text, tagged commander, card count and warnings. Excludes sideboards and Moxfield companions; no private access or saved server copy. Follow with a deck-review tool to validate names and legality. If Moxfield access is blocked, do not repeat the URL request. Ask for Download > Copy Plain Text, with the commander line marked *CMDR*.
name: import_deck
title: Import a public Commander deck URL
